payload.title: Production ran the 2026-10-22 build for six days because the development deploy refuses any run whose commit is no longer the head of main, and a CI run outlasts the interval between merges to main
evidence: scripts/deploy/droplet-capacity.sh:67 (the full-deploy byte floor that refused the deploy once the stale check let a run through)
.github/workflows/deploy-development.yml:70 (refuses a deploy when the run commit differs from current main)
.github/workflows/deploy-development.yml:156 (the same refusal repeated before the deploy job)
payload.rule_violated: A merged commit reaches production, or the refusal names a retry path; a gate that can only fail while main keeps moving is not a gate (plan section 3, ADR 051 release train)
payload.notes: Runs 3c9daf3a6b and 11fe762dce on 2026-10-27 were refused as stale (main had moved on); b665d6f801 then failed the disk floor. Fix direction: deploy the newest green commit of main instead of the run commit, so a later merge supersedes the deploy instead of cancelling it.
